svg.title: Fibey Field Ops: system architecture
svg.desc: React UI proxies chat through FastAPI, which translates the authenticated hosted Responses API into SSE and preserves previous_response_id continuity. The Foundry-hosted ResponsesHostServer connects to one Toolbox MCP endpoint. Tool calls reach Inventory MCP, Work Orders OpenAPI, and FoundryIQ. MCP Resources reach five workflow skills via McpSkillsSource and SkillsProvider with load_skill activity. The status dashboard is a separate, unconnected Container App requiring additional browser-tool configuration. Local mode runs the agent inside the gateway. Git skill files are published through postdeploy REST to versioned Foundry skills and Toolbox references.

g.text: Hosted deployment: five Azure Container Apps and one Foundry-hosted agent

g.text: The gateway runs the agent in-process; Toolbox tools and the MCP skill-resource path stay the same.
skills/<name>/SKILL.md -> postdeploy REST publisher -> versioned Foundry skills -> Toolbox references
Official Azure service icons: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center (V24).
